name: CD3×5T4 In Vitro Activation and Cytotoxicity QSP
description: Fixed-effect in vitro model linking CD3×5T4 immune-synapse formation to T-cell activation, differentiation, and delayed tumor-cell killing.

BsAb.name: Free CD3×5T4 bispecific antibody
BsAb.description: Free bispecific concentration in the well after depletion by binding to CD3 and 5T4.

CD3.name: Free CD3 per T cell
CD3.description: Unoccupied CD3 molecules on the representative T cell, subject to turnover, binding, and proliferation dilution.

CD3_BsAb.name: CD3-bound binary complex
CD3_BsAb.description: Binary complex between cell-surface CD3 and the bispecific before 5T4 crosslinking.

TAA.name: Free 5T4 per tumor cell
TAA.description: Unoccupied 5T4 molecules on the representative tumor cell, subject to turnover, binding, and proliferation dilution.

TAA_BsAb.name: 5T4-bound binary complex
TAA_BsAb.description: Binary complex between cell-surface 5T4 and the bispecific before CD3 crosslinking.

trimer.name: CD3×bispecific×5T4 immune-synapse trimer
trimer.description: Ternary CD3×bispecific×5T4 complexes per T cell in the modeled immune synapse.

Tr.name: Resting T cells
Tr.description: Resting T cells available for trimer-dependent activation.

Ta.name: Activated T cells
Ta.description: Activated, proliferating T cells that can differentiate into the effector pool.

Ta_generation_counter.name: Activated T-cell generation counter
Ta_generation_counter.description: Population-level activated-cell generation counter controlling the differentiation rate.

Te.name: Effector T cells
Te.description: Differentiated effector T cells that contribute aggregate trimer-dependent tumor killing.

Te_generation_counter.name: Effector T-cell generation counter
Te_generation_counter.description: Population-level effector generation counter inherited from differentiating activated cells.

tumor_cell.name: Viable tumor cells
tumor_cell.description: Proliferating viable tumor cells that can enter the first apoptosis transit stage after effector-mediated killing.

apoT1.name: Apoptotic tumor stage 1
apoT1.description: First delayed-death transit population receiving the tumor-cell killing flux.

apoT2.name: Apoptotic tumor stage 2
apoT2.description: Second delayed-death transit population in the three-stage apoptosis chain.

apoT3.name: Apoptotic tumor stage 3
apoT3.description: Final delayed-death transit population before cells accumulate in the dead-tumor state.

dead_tumor.name: Dead tumor cells
dead_tumor.description: Cumulative tumor cells that have exited the final apoptosis transit stage.

tumor_without_drug.name: Untreated control tumor cells
tumor_without_drug.description: Parallel untreated tumor trajectory used as the denominator and reference for model-derived cytotoxicity.

KD_CD3_3D_nM.name: CD3 arm 3D dissociation constant
KD_CD3_3D_nM.description: DuoBody-CD3x5T4 value; the high-affinity bsIgG1 variant is 16 nM. Values between the endpoints are exploratory and values outside them are outside this runtime contract.

KD_CD3_2D_low_molecules_per_cell.name: CD3 2D dissociation constant at 16 nM 3D affinity

KD_CD3_2D_high_molecules_per_cell.name: CD3 2D dissociation constant at 683 nM 3D affinity

base_TAA_molecules_per_tumor.name: Baseline 5T4 abundance
base_TAA_molecules_per_tumor.description: MDA-MB-468 default from Supplement Table S1.

Max_activation_per_hr.name: Maximum T-cell activation rate
Max_activation_per_hr.description: Upper rate of trimer-dependent resting-to-activated T-cell conversion in the fixed-effect model.

Max_kill_per_effector_hr.name: Maximum per-effector tumor killing rate
Max_kill_per_effector_hr.description: MDA-MB-468 cell-line group 4 and no-donor/donor group 2 value.

EC50_killing_total_trimers.name: Aggregate trimer threshold for half-maximal killing
EC50_killing_total_trimers.description: Aggregate trimer load across effector T cells producing half-maximal per-effector killing drive.

source.paper_title: CD3×5T4 In Vitro Activation and Cytotoxicity QSP
